title: Login Success with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that users can successfully log in with valid username/email and password, receiving a valid JWT and refresh token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify that login succeeds and JWT access token and refresh token are returned.

title: Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails with incorrect username/email or password, and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input invalid username/email or password.
Click the login button.
Verify that login fails with an error message and no token is issued.

title: Access Protected Endpoint with Valid JWT
description: Verify that authenticated users with valid JWT can access protected API endpoints according to their RBAC role.

steps.description: Log in to obtain a valid JWT token.
Make API call to a protected endpoint (e.g., /api/funcionarios) with valid JWT.
Verify the endpoint returns data according to user's role permissions.

title: Access Protected Endpoint with Expired JWT and Use Refresh Token
description: Verify that when JWT expires, the refresh token can be used to obtain a new JWT without user having to re-login.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain JWT and refresh token.
Simulate JWT expiry by using expired token.
Use refresh token endpoint to obtain a new JWT.
Verify new valid JWT is issued and user can access protected resources with it.

title: RBAC Authorization Restricts Access Based on Role
description: Verify that users with different roles (e.g., ADMIN, USER, AUDITOR) have access only to allowed endpoints and operations.

steps.description: Log in as ADMIN user.
Access all major API endpoints and verify access granted.
Log in as AUDITOR user.
Attempt to perform data modification operations and verify access denied.
Verify RBAC properly restricts unauthorized access based on roles.

title: Funcionario CRUD Operations
description: Verify full CRUD operations on Funcionarios including create, read, update, delete and import via CSV with validation.

steps.description: Create a new funcionario with all required regulatory data (ANAC, ASO, CMA).
Verify funcionario is stored and retrievable via /api/funcionarios/:id.
Update funcionario details.
Verify changes are saved and reflected.
Perform soft delete on a funcionario.
Verify funcionario is soft deleted and no longer appears in active lists.
Import funcionarios via CSV upload to /api/funcionarios/import.
Verify bulk import validations, successful creations, and error handling for invalid records.

title: Certificacao Upload, Download and Expiry Alert
description: Verify uploading and downloading certificacoes works correctly with file sync on R2 storage and expiry alert notifications.

steps.description: Upload certificate file to /api/qualificacoes/:id/upload-certificado.
Verify certificate file is stored in R2 and accessible.
Download certificate file from /api/certificados/:id.
Verify file contents match uploaded certificate.
Simulate approaching certificate expiry.
Verify system triggers alert and marks certificate as expiring.

title: Training Catalog Listing and Subscription
description: Verify users can access catalog of treinamentos, filter by category and periodicity, and subscribe colaboradores to trainings.

steps.description: Request list of treinamentos from /api/v2/treinamentos.
Verify the list includes trainings with correct categories and periodicity.
Filter training catalog by category.
Verify filtered list returns trainings only for selected category.
Subscribe a funcionario to a training.
Verify subscription is recorded and visible in user's training records.

title: Simulator Session Scheduling and PDF Report Generation
description: Verify scheduling simulator sessions, filling session evaluation forms, and generating detailed PDF reports.

steps.description: Schedule a new simulator session via /api/v2/simuladores/sessoes.
Verify session is created and retrievable.
Fill out evaluation form for the session using /api/v2/simuladores/fichas.
Verify evaluation form data is saved.
Request PDF report generation for the evaluation form.
Verify PDF is generated correctly with all required evaluation details.

title: Virtual Folder Document Upload, Download, and Sync
description: Verify upload and download of documents in virtual folder with proper sync and permissions enforced.

steps.description: Upload a document to the virtual folder via /api/v2/pasta-virtual.
Verify document is stored in Cloudflare R2 and listed correctly.
Download the stored document.
Verify the downloaded document matches the uploaded content.
Simulate concurrent uploads and verify synchronization does not cause conflicts.
Verify all documents remain consistent and accessible.

title: Compliance Status Auto-Update and Expiry Matrix
description: Verify compliance module automatically updates statuses and maintains an accurate regulatory expiry matrix.

steps.description: Trigger compliance status calculation or wait for scheduled run.
Verify statuses are correctly updated and reflect current data.
Access compliance expiry matrix dashboard.
Verify matrix correctly lists all upcoming expiries and compliance statuses.

title: Dashboard Metrics and KPI Real-time Updates
description: Verify that dashboard displays accurate real-time operational metrics and KPIs from backend.

steps.description: Access dashboard page.
Verify initial metrics load correctly from /api/v2/dashboard.
Simulate data changes in backend.
Verify dashboard updates metrics and KPIs in real-time without refresh.

title: Audit Log Visibility and Protection
description: Verify that audit logs are recorded for all operations and are accessible only to authorized users.

steps.description: Perform create, update, delete operations on employee data.
Verify audit logs record details with timestamps and user actions.
Attempt to access audit logs as ADMIN user.
Verify access is granted to authorized roles.
Attempt to access audit logs as non-authorized user.
Verify access is denied.

title: Rate Limiting on Import Endpoint
description: Verify that /api/funcionarios/import endpoint enforces rate limiting to prevent abuse, allows only ADMIN role.

steps.description: Attempt multiple rapid import requests as ADMIN user.
Verify rate limiting is applied and excess requests are rejected.
Attempt import as non-ADMIN user.
Verify access is denied.

title: Soft Delete Persistence and Restore
description: Verify that soft deleted records are not shown in active queries and can be restored if needed.

steps.description: Soft delete a funcionario record.
Verify the record is not returned in normal listing endpoints.
Restore the soft deleted funcionario.
Verify the record appears again in active listings.

title: SQL Injection Protection on Input Endpoints
description: Verify that all input endpoints properly sanitize and parameterize queries to prevent SQL Injection.

steps.description: Attempt to submit SQL injection payloads on input fields (e.g., funcionario create, update).
Verify payload does not alter database schema or execute unintended commands.

title: CORS Policy Enforcement
description: Verify backend API endpoints enforce CORS policies allowing only trusted origins.

steps.description: Make API requests from approved origin.
Verify requests succeed with proper CORS headers.
Make API requests from non-approved origin.
Verify requests are blocked due to CORS policy.

title: API Health and Version Endpoints
description: Verify that /api/health and /api/version endpoints respond correctly with up-to-date status and version information.

steps.description: Request /api/health endpoint.
Verify response is 200 OK with service health information.
Request /api/version endpoint.
Verify response returns current software version as documented.

title: Frontend Accessibility Keyboard Navigation
description: Verify full keyboard navigation usability across the interface including focus visibility and ARIA labels.

steps.description: Navigate through all major pages and UI components using keyboard only.
Verify focus is visible on all interactive elements and ARIA labels are present.
Use screen reader to navigate key UI sections.
Verify content is properly announced and navigation is logical.

title: Performance with Virtual Scrolling and Cache on Large Lists
description: Verify virtual scrolling and React Query intelligent cache reduce rendering and loading times for tables with 500+ items.

steps.description: Load funcionario list with more than 500 entries.
Verify UI uses virtual scrolling with minimal rendering and scrolling is smooth.
Navigate away and back to the list.
Verify cached data is used and load times are reduced.
